name: Paper Trade
description: Open and manage a simulated paper trade from a documented thesis.
purpose: Validate trade discipline in simulation before any future guarded execution is considered.

stages.name: Thesis Check
stages.description: Confirm the trade has a real thesis before simulation starts.

steps.label: Link the paper trade to an existing thesis or create the missing thesis first.
Confirm entry, stop, target, risk amount, position size, and invalidation.

stages.name: Simulation Tracking
stages.description: Track the simulated trade and preserve journal context.

steps.label: Open the simulated paper trade only. No broker, exchange, or real order is used.
Track status, notes, screenshots, and exit conditions until closure.

userFacingBlurb: Open a simulation-only trade from a documented setup.
